data.name: Mummification
data.description: You have mastered preserving flesh and applied this knowledge to your own body, turning yourself into an undeadlike creature. After learning this discovery, you must perform a 30-day regimen of a special diet, rigorous exercise, and drinking a mildly poisonous alchemical tea. At the end of this regimen, you fall unconscious for 24 hours, then awaken as a "living mummy." Your type does not change, but you become immune to cold, nonlethal damage, paralysis, and sleep.
